newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Enron's Venezuela exploration starts in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Enron's Venezuela exploration starts in Nov.

text.p: Enron Corp will start exploring for crude and natural gas in northeastern Venezuela in November, Enron President Kent Lay said Thursday.
"The initial investment will be $30 million, but if we are successful we will invest hundreds of millions more," Lay told reporters in Miraflores presidential palace.
Enron won the exploration and production rights to the off- shore tract known as Golfo de Paria Este in a bidding round earlier this year.
Enron holds 90 percent of the consortium which won the rights to the tract. Venezuela's Inelectra holds the remaining 10 percent.

Once exploration is over a subsidiary of state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) will have an option to take up to a 35 percent stake in a profit-sharing agreement to produce and sell crude and gas from the site.
